bars.name: DRAFT
bars.does: the hero word is pressed flat into the line

words.role: hero: fitted to the safe width, the film's first and last frame

bars.name: TYPE
bars.does: words live in a slot between two rails that resize to fit each word

words.role: slot word: lives between the rails, the rails resize to fit it
slot word: lives between the rails, the rails resize to fit it

bars.name: CURVE
bars.does: pen-tool handles bend the line; copies fan; travelling sines

words.role: slot word: lives between the rails, the rails resize to fit it

bars.name: MORPH
bars.does: the line curls into a circle (length kept), then triangle, square, hexagon; hatching builds

bars.name: TILE
bars.does: honeycomb; hatching floods solid; the centre cell floods the frame into blueprint

bars.name: SOLID
bars.does: each hexagon becomes a cube seen corner-on; they merge; perspective turns on

bars.name: GEAR
bars.does: the front face grows teeth; a meshing gear train steps on eighth notes

bars.name: PANEL
bars.does: the cube unfolds into six panels that become a dashboard of the user's real numbers

bars.name: DATA
bars.does: a playhead runs at the real time; a cursor clicks a mode switch; a scan line turns it to light

bars.name: LIGHT
bars.does: the chart stands up as lit solids

bars.name: WAVE
bars.does: their tops join into a travelling surface that flattens into the line

bars.name: END
bars.does: the line lifts into the rail and the hero word rises back; the last frame is the first
